{{Short description|Early hand-held calculator}}
[[Image:Canon palmtronic 17o06.jpg|right|280px|thumb|Canon Palmtronic LE-80M calculator (on 5cm squares)]]

The '''Canon Palmtronic LE-80M''' is an early hand-held [[calculator]]. It was manufactured by [[Canon (company)|Canon inc]]. Unlike other models which used a processing chip manufactured by [[Texas Instruments]] the LE-80M used a [[Hitachi]] HD3553 chip.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.datamath.org/Related/Canon/LE-80M.htm|title=DATAMATH|website=www.datamath.org|access-date=2018-09-28}}</ref>    When first released in 1973, it retailed for $138.45.<ref Name="Kiplinger ">{{cite book |title= Kiplinger's Personal Finance; Vol. 27, No. 7|year= 1973|publisher= Kiplinger Washington Editors, Inc.|id= 528-9729|page= 41|url= https://books.google.com/books?id=OQYEAAAAMBAJ&pg=PA41}}</ref>
